source: Ahrefs site-explorer-referring-domains, livdar.com, live links, top 40 by domain rating
interpretation: The 611 referring domains reported on 2026-09-20 are not authority. The strongest 40 are automated SEO directory and link shop sites, 32 of them flagged spam by Ahrefs, 39 nofollow, none ranking for anything.
Several were first seen in February to April 2026, before the site launched on this domain, so they are domain level noise, not something Livdar acquired.
Google generally ignores this kind of link. No disavow is proposed from a 40 row sample; revisit only if Search Console reports a manual action.
The real gap to Airalo, Holafly and Saily (15,797, 16,006 and 8,979 referring domains in data/competitor-validation-2026-09-20.json) is legitimate editorial links, which start at zero.
